problems.title: AI-Based Student Early Warning System
problems.summary: Academic risk prediction system utilizing attendance records, test marks, and assignment indicators to forecast student risk levels with explanations and actionable intervention recommendations.
problems.problemDescription: Educational institutions require proactive identification of students who may be at risk of academic failure or dropping out. An AI-based early warning system evaluates key longitudinal student data points including continuous attendance records, internal exam marks, and submission timelines for assignments to detect early patterns of academic distress.
problems.challenge: Design and implement an intelligent predictive system that evaluates academic indicators, quantifies risk probabilities, provides clear interpretability/explanations for flagged risk factors, and recommends specific academic interventions.
problems.expectedOutput: A functional AI risk assessment engine and dashboard that ingests student academic and attendance indicators, computes normalized risk scores (Low, Moderate, High), highlights root contributing factors for each student, and generates structured intervention guidance for faculty mentors.
functionalScope: Multi-metric risk scoring using attendance, test scores, and assignment completion velocity
Risk explanation breakdown detailing specific drop-off triggers
Actionable recommendations and remediation plans for at-risk cohorts
Student and mentor view showing risk trajectory over time
problems.rulesReferences: 90-Minute Prototype Building Period. Presentation 60%, Prototype 40%. Prototype evaluated by AI.
problems.evaluationCriteria: Presentation (60%), Functional Prototype (40% evaluated by AI).

problems.title: AI-Powered Resume & Job Matching System
problems.summary: Intelligent career alignment engine analyzing candidate resumes against job descriptions to compute compatibility scores, highlight matched proficiencies, and pinpoint skill gaps.
problems.problemDescription: Recruiters and students often struggle with manual alignment of technical proficiencies against detailed job specifications. This system performs semantic parsing and contextual extraction on candidate resumes and target job roles to calculate accurate match ratings and highlight missing prerequisites.
problems.challenge: Develop an AI parsing and semantic scoring module that ingests resume texts and job descriptions, extracts competencies, benchmarks alignment, and provides detailed skill gap diagnostics.
problems.expectedOutput: A functional matching engine generating percentage compatibility ratings, itemized breakdown of matching technical and non-technical skills, and actionable recommendations for missing requirements.
functionalScope: Resume and job description text parsing and entity extraction
Contextual skill matching and weighted compatibility scoring
Identification of missing prerequisites and curriculum gaps
Personalized skill enhancement suggestions based on industry demand
problems.rulesReferences: 90-Minute Prototype Building Period. Presentation 60%, Prototype 40%. Prototype evaluated by AI.
problems.evaluationCriteria: Presentation (60%), Functional Prototype (40% evaluated by AI).

problems.title: AI-Powered Campus Support Assistant
problems.summary: Institutional conversational intelligence providing verified answers to student queries using institutional FAQs/documents while autonomously flagging unanswered questions.
problems.problemDescription: College administrative departments receive repetitive queries regarding academic regulations, examination schedules, fee structures, and campus services. This assistant grounds responses strictly in official college documentation and flags unaddressed or ambiguous questions for human staff review.
problems.challenge: Construct a grounded conversational assistant that accurately retrieves and articulates answers from institutional knowledge bases while logging fallback/unanswered queries for continuous knowledge base enrichment.
problems.expectedOutput: An interactive support interface that answers campus-related inquiries with high precision, cites institutional reference points, and maintains an administrative queue of unresolved queries.
functionalScope: Document-grounded question answering for campus regulations and services
Strict hallucination guardrails preventing false campus information
Automated logging and classification of unanswered or ambiguous questions
Escalation workflow for administrative desk resolution
problems.rulesReferences: 90-Minute Prototype Building Period. Presentation 60%, Prototype 40%. Prototype evaluated by AI.
problems.evaluationCriteria: Presentation (60%), Functional Prototype (40% evaluated by AI).

problems.title: Intelligent Phishing & Scam Detection
problems.summary: Cybersecurity classification engine evaluating suspicious URLs, communication payloads, and text snippets to detect malicious intent and alert users with risk indicators.
problems.problemDescription: Cyber threats, deceptive campus phishing emails, and predatory job scam messages increasingly target students and faculty. This solution inspects communication payloads, analyzes linguistic and structural anomalies, assesses domain legitimacy, and outputs real-time safety warnings.
problems.challenge: Build a machine-learning-driven classification pipeline that classifies URLs and text messages as legitimate or phishing, pinpointing specific suspicious signals such as spoofed domains or urgency tactics.
problems.expectedOutput: A real-time inspection tool that accepts message bodies or hyperlinks, provides instant classification (Safe, Suspicious, Malicious), and displays explicit risk factors explaining why the target was flagged.
functionalScope: Feature extraction for lexical patterns, URL redirects, and deceptive phrasing
Probability score and risk categorization
Clear risk indicators (e.g., mismatched TLD, urgent credential requests)
User-friendly warning recommendations and safety tips
problems.rulesReferences: 90-Minute Prototype Building Period. Presentation 60%, Prototype 40%. Prototype evaluated by AI.
problems.evaluationCriteria: Presentation (60%), Functional Prototype (40% evaluated by AI).

Temporal trend analysis showing peak generation hours and seasonal variance
Hotspot mapping across dining halls, residential blocks, and academic facilities
Actionable waste mitigation and resource diversion recommendations

problems.title: Campus Lost & Found
problems.summary: Community-driven property recovery platform featuring categorized item reporting, timestamped locations, search indexing, potential match suggestions, and verification workflow.
problems.problemDescription: Lost identity cards, calculators, electronics, and keys are frequently misplaced across campus grounds with no streamlined return mechanism. This platform enables swift reporting of lost or discovered items, matches candidates using descriptive tags and locations, and facilitates safe item returns.
problems.challenge: Build a community web application that manages lost and found listings, indexes items by category/date/location, detects potential matches between lost and found logs, and secures ownership claim verification.
problems.expectedOutput: A responsive recovery portal showcasing active item feeds, search and tag filtering, report filing forms for lost and found items, match suggestion badges, and a secure claiming workflow.
functionalScope: Structured report logging for both lost and found belongings
Granular filtering by item category, campus location, and incident date
Algorithmic candidate match indicator comparing lost descriptions with found items
Secure claim verification procedure and recovery status lifecycle

constraints.title: Resilient Offline Fallback Layer
constraints.description: Prototypes must incorporate local caching or mock fallback data to maintain operational integrity in the event of upstream network timeouts or simulated API disconnections.

constraints.title: Sub-Second Inference Latency Guardrail
constraints.description: The early warning assessment engine must return normalized risk levels and causal explanation breakdowns within 1.5 seconds per cohort query batch.

constraints.title: Keyboard-First Accessibility Protocol
constraints.description: All primary portal interactions (notice filtering, schedule switching, service requests) must be fully navigable via keyboard with distinct focus rings and zero mouse reliance.
